bio: Treat yourself to a scrumptious Afternoon Tea at Colquhoun's Restaurant and enjoy unrivalled panoramic views of the Loch and Ben Lomond.  Housed inside the charming Lodge on Loch Lamond Hotel, Colquhoun's Restaurant provides a tranquil setting for guests to relax, unwind and indulge in the Great British tradition of Afternoon Tea. With its cosy interior and impressive floor-to-ceiling windows, guests can dine whilst marvelling at the Loch and its surrounding moutains.  Their Afternoon Tea menu comprises a selection of mouth-watering finger sandwiches and savouries, freshly-baked scones with clotted cream and jam, followed by a delectable sweet plate. Indulge in the likes of a rich chocolate Brownie and a decadent Carrot Cake, all served alongside your your choice of organic tea. For those extra special occasions, why not upgrade to include a glass of sparkling wine or even Champagne?  Colquhouns Restaurant sits in the picturesque village of Luss, just a short drive from Balloch Railway Station and 45 minutes from Glasgow.
